component.name: Redot Engine
component.summary: Multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine with a feature-rich editor

description.p: Redot is a community fork of the Godot engine: a feature-packed, multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine with an integrated editor, scripted in GDScript. It provides a large set of common tools, so you can focus on making your game without reinventing the wheel.
Redot is free and open source under the MIT license. No royalties, no strings attached: your game is yours, down to the last line of engine code.

This is a community package: it installs the official Linux editor build from upstream's releases unmodified and follows new releases automatically. It is the standard build; the .NET (C#) build needs a .NET SDK and is not packaged.

The editor can read and write your home directory, where it keeps projects by default. Gamepads for testing a running game are not shared by default; enable them with flatpak override --user --device=all org.redotengine.Redot and undo it with flatpak override --user --reset org.redotengine.Redot.
